name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 21 – Am 19
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 21c. Calls for the principle of economic, social and territorial cohesion to be defined as a horizontal principle in the EU budget, making the assessment of the impact on cohesion between and within Member States of all expenditure, policies or actions a requirement, with the aim of promoting effective convergence in economic and social progress;
